bias.en: Bearish · rebound reclaimed $115, SAR overhead at $119.8
bias.zh: 看空 · 反弹收复 $115，SAR 压制于 $119.8

read.en: Corning rose 9.3% on Nov 9 to $115.95, trading $108.05–116.42. It closed above the falling 5-day average ($114.1) but below the falling 10-day ($120.3), 30-day ($137.5) and 100-day ($157.5) and the rising 200-day ($156.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($119.76), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 康宁 11月9日上涨 9.3%，收于 $115.95，盘中区间 $108.05–116.42。股价收于下行的 5 日均线（$114.1）上方，但仍低于下行的 10 日（$120.3）、30 日（$137.5）和 100 日均线（$157.5），以及上行的 200 日均线（$156.3）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$119.76），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The rally broke the $110 cap and the $114.1–115.4 band (5-day, Nov 5 high, Jul 28 and Nov 4 lows), now support. Resistance is $119.8–120.5 (SAR, 10-day, Oct 30 low), then $123.2–123.8 (Nov 2 close, Nov 4 high) and $129.85 (Nov 3 high). Support is $114.1–115.4, then $108–110.5 and $104.1. A close above $120.5 would target $123–124; below $114.1, $110.
